 Posted Nov 3, 2026 at 3:29 PM UTC A Andrew Liszewski Lego’s 5,363-piece Godzilla stands over 27-inches tall. As part of the annual Godzilla Day celebrations, Lego has announced a towering brick-built Godzilla model featuring an adjustable tail, a posable head, arms, and fingers, and an attachable tongue that can be swapped for a heat ray blast. It will set you back a hefty $449.99 when it becomes available on November 27th.
